lessons.title: Grammar: used to
lessons.concepts:
• Use used to for past habits
  • Make negatives and questions with use to
  • Talk about what you used to do when little
lessons.warmup: When I was little: Teacher says three things she used to do; students guess which is true.
lessons.procedures:
1. Study the grammar table.

    UseFormExample
    Positiveused to + verbThey used to throw buckets of water.
    Negativedidn't use to + verbThey didn't use to call firefighters.
    QuestionDid ... use to ...?Did she use to live in a wooden house? Yes, she did. / No, she didn't.

  2. Rules.

    Used to is for things that happened many times in the past. We use 'use to' (not 'used to') for questions and negatives.

  3. Find examples in the dialogue (Activity 3).

    The buildings used to be wooden. They just used to throw buckets of water over fires.

  4. Talk (Activity 7).

    Prompts: play with toys, go to school, ride a bike, drink milk, talk to my friends, play football, sing songs, read books. Models: I used to play with my toys. I didn't use to ride a bike.

  5. مرحلة النشاط الجماعي: «عندما كنا صغاراً».
